capabilities: insert links or plain-text lists of files created or modified between dates
insert stats tables of file counts per date using natural language dates
track file creation, modification, deletion and rename events in a database
export activity data to CSV or JSON on a schedule
extras: Author calls the plugin 'very young and written quickly'; one command ('Today's Stats') is marked deprecated and slated for removal; future plans include writing-velocity metrics and memory optimizations for large vaults.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see which files you created or edited on a given day or range and record that activity in a note.

relations.evidence: uses the Obsidian Charts plugin for visualizations if available

summary: File-activity reporting plugin that inserts lists, stats tables, timelines and dashboards of files created or modified over a date range.
